profile.positioning:
As CTO and co-founder of RegFlow, I'm driven by a simple, yet crucial mission: to level the playing field for community banks and credit unions. These institutions are vital to local economies, but they often struggle under the weight of increasingly complex regulatory requirements. RegFlow offers a no-code automation platform that streamlines regulatory reporting, reduces compliance costs, and frees up valuable resources for these organizations to focus on their core business – serving their communities. 

My background is somewhat unconventional for a startup founder. I spent the first ten years of my career as a core developer building high-frequency trading systems for a proprietary trading firm. That experience ingrained in me a deep appreciation for system reliability, performance, and the critical importance of precision.  We operated in an environment where milliseconds mattered, and a single bug could cost millions.  I’m bringing that same rigor and attention to detail to the fintech automation space. 

We’ve recently achieved significant traction, onboarding our first five pilot customers and demonstrating a 70% reduction in reporting time for one key regulatory form. We're now focused on scaling our platform, expanding our team, and securing Seed funding to accelerate our growth. My vision is to build RegFlow into the leading automation solution for financial institutions of all sizes, empowering them to navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape with confidence.
